question: Who may consecrate all the items with the Bahurūpa mantra as an alternative?
premises: The Bahurūpa mantra is given as an alternative.
All the items may be consecrated with it.
The best teacher is the one who performs the consecration.
inference: Alternatively, the best teacher may consecrate all the items with the Bahurūpa mantra.
plain_english: Or the best teacher may consecrate all the items with the Bahurūpa mantra.
